asset_management_guidelines.content: Asset Management Guidelines v2.3: (1) Only designs tagged BOTH 'approved' and 'q1-2026' are eligible for export. (2) Verify Status = Final before export. (3) Exported PNGs must be placed in the matching Target Folder named in the asset register. (4) Channel announcements to #design-team require sign-off from the requesting manager and must include verbatim design names, the Drive folder link, and an accurate count of assets. (5) Update Export Status only after files are confirmed in the folder.
